description: Na₂CeO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-12°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four CeO₆ octahedra, edges with four CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra.
